text:
deploy-bot: kicking off staged rollout v4.0.0 -> 10% us-west (commit b9a4c2d)
deploy-bot: release-notes: https://ci.redwood/release/4.0.0 ; note: routing weight refactor + prefix-caching improvements
cassie: heads up — change window overlap with infra-maintenance at 02:00 UTC? we scheduled quiet window at 02:15 earlier :calendar:
arjun: saw a small spike in cross-region tail latency immediately after shift, suspect routing weight calc sending some traffic to older pop with higher RTT
nora: checking traces — a handful of user sessions got routed across regions due to stale affinity table entries (sticky sessions)
jake: sticky sessions? we should not be cross-routing on this rollout. did the weight refactor change affinity TTL semantics?
infra-bot: rollout-runner: affinity-ttl default reduced from 10m -> 30s in commit b9a4c2d (see PR #7821)
arjun: that would explain it — short TTL causing re-affinity while requests mid-stream, leading to cold KV cache hits and p99 spike
cassie: can we do a regional pin to contain blast radius while we revert the affinity change? also need to avoid colliding with infra maintenance at 02:15
jake: yes. regional pin + pause. keep other regions at 10% if healthy
deploy-bot: recommended commands:
```
# pause rollout in us-west
redwood rollout set --commit b9a4c2d --region us-west --percent 0 --reason "pause: affinity-ttl regression"
# pin routes back to previous version
redwood route set --region us-west --from v4.0.0 --to v3.9.7 --force
```
deploy-bot: executed at 4456789020. v4.0.0 traffic set to 0% in us-west
nora: metrics: 95p and p99 tail latencies returning to baseline within 40s :thumbsup:
infra-bot: maintenance reschedule? infra team proposes shift to 03:00 UTC to avoid overlap; filing change: https://infra.redwood/change/mt-904
cassie: good. follow-ups: revert affinity-ttl change in a hotfix branch, add an integration test for session-affinity TTL, and add a canary probe that exercises long-lived sessions
jack: (typo) jake: i'll file the hotfix PR and loop in serving-runtime for quick review
arjun: capture replay of affected sessions for debug: s3://canary-replays/4456789012/us-west-affinity-replay.tar.gz
cassie: decision: regional pause + pin. delay global progression until hotfix validated in a constrained small-bake. notify stakeholders and update release notes: "us-west partial rollout paused due to affinity TTL regression; pinned to v3.9.7 pending fix"
deploy-bot: note: thread closed at 4456789028. re-open with `redwood deploy reopen --thread 4456789012` if needed
nora: thanks team — i'll coordinate the small-bake and handoff for the hotfix.
